relatedItems.titleZh: 哈贾尔时隔三站重返赛场，斩获生涯第三个领奖台
relatedItems.summaryZh: 官方账号发帖祝贺法国车手伊萨克·哈贾尔：在连续缺席三场比赛后，他回归并拿下职业生涯第三个领奖台。

media.altZh: 哈贾尔时隔三站重返赛场，斩获生涯第三个领奖台

relatedItems.originalTitle: We see you, Isack! 😍 After three races on the sidelines, the Frenchman came back and claimed the third podium of his career 💪 #F1 #AzerbaijanGP ...
relatedItems.summaryEn:
We see you, Isack! 😍
After three races on the sidelines, the Frenchman came back and claimed the third podium of his career 💪
#F1 #AzerbaijanGP @redbullracing
detailZh: 我们看见你了，伊萨克！😍 在连续三站比赛缺席之后，这位法国车手回归并夺得了职业生涯的第三个领奖台 💪 #F1 #阿塞拜疆大奖赛 @redbullracing
detailEn:
We see you, Isack! 😍
After three races on the sidelines, the Frenchman came back and claimed the third podium of his career 💪
#F1 #AzerbaijanGP @redbullracing
keyPointsZh: 这是哈贾尔职业生涯的第三个领奖台。
此前他曾连续三站比赛没有参赛。
本站比赛为阿塞拜疆大奖赛。
keyPointsEn: He had previously missed three races while on the sidelines.
